title: Racial Proportions in Current Immigration Policy
what_it_is: Racial Proportions in Current Immigration Policy

sections.label: Stable ethnic proportions of citizens
sections.summary: Over the last 10 years, citizen ethnic proportions stayed at 76% Chinese, 15% Malay, 7.5% Indian and 1.5% Others.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: If you look back, the ethnic proportion of our citizen population has actually remained stable.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In the last 10 years, the proportion of citizens of Chinese ethnicity has remained at 76%, Malay ethnicity at 15%, Indian ethnicity at 7.5%, and Others at 1.5%.
